A '''scientist''' was assigned to conduct research in [[Lord Grathan's estate]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="Encounter" /> In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> the scientist went rogue and poisoned fellow researchers and stole [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] research with the intent of selling it to the Galactic Republic. The operation was discovered when Imperial authorities detected unauthorized communication activity transmitting from the estate to Republic space. An Imperial officer subsequently ordered that Grathan's research be secured.<ref name="Encounter" />

==Behind the scenes==
The rogue scientist first appeared in the dynamic encounter mission "Power Stolen,"<ref name="Encounter" /> introduced in Game Update 7.7: ''Dynamic Worlds'', released on [[May 28]], [[2025]], as part of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]'',<ref name="Dynamic Worlds">{{TORweb|url=info/news/%5Bnews-category%5D/20250528-1|text=Game Update 7.7 "Dynamic Worlds" is now live!}}</ref> the eighth digital expansion to the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Announcement">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20210701|text=Announcing Legacy of the Sith, the next expansion for Star Wars: The Old Republic}}</ref>
